name: Baron Sengir
description: An ancient Vampire Lord stranded on Ulgrotha who conquered the dwarves' castle and rules the Dark Barony.

timeline.summary: On the evening Feroz died, the Autumn Willow has a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir.
timeline.quote: On the evening that Feroz died, the Autumn Willow had a prophetic vision of Baron Sengir leading an army through the Dwarven Gate beneath Castle Sengir .

citation.text: "Autumn Willow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Young Ihsan is told by a soothsayer that his dreams mean he is likely doomed by Baron Sengir, and devotes himself to becoming a paladin of Serra.
timeline.quote: Ihsan devoted his life to becoming a Paladin of Serra

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ihsan confronts Baron Sengir and begs to become a vampire so as to defeat him.
timeline.quote: Lord Ihsan knelt before the Baron and begged that the Sengir make him into a creature of eternity

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir drains Ihsan and instead makes him a ghost bound to his signet ring.
timeline.quote: Binding the paladin's soul to his signet ring

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A plague of rats kills most of Ravi's village, including her mother; she meets the baron's son, who teaches her a song to control the rats to kill the baron.
timeline.quote: To do this, the boy taught her a song that could control the rats.

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravi commands the rats to kill the baron after finding him working on her mother's corpse; the baron's boy is revived by his father's last spell.
timeline.quote: Ravi took her opportunity and ordered the rats to kill the baron.

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravi is introduced to the new Baron Sengir, who is intolerant of light.
timeline.quote: Ravi was thus introduced to the new Baron Sengir .

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The vampire Baron Sengir frees Ravi, neither recognizing the other, and takes her to his castle as Grandmother Sengir and his tutor.
timeline.quote: she was freed by her childhood friend, the Baron Sengir , now a full-fledged vampire

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the eve of the Mending, Sengir and Ihsan leave Ulgrotha at the head of a vampire army; Ravi stays and later defends Ulgrotha in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind on Ulgrotha, and participated in the plane's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Ravi Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir's father tries to become an immortal through black magic and vampirism, bringing his son along.
timeline.quote: The baron intended to become an immortal and he had begun the path towards vampirism, bringing with him his son.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Young Sengir and the orphan Ravi lead plague rats against the baron; the rats kill the boy and the baron, and Sengir revives as a vampire.
timeline.quote: However, he was visibly hurt by the sunlight and receded to a dark corner of the room, hinting at his now complete transformation into a vampire.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries later Sengir is summoned during a planeswalker duel and stranded on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: Centuries later, Baron Sengir was summoned during a planeswalker duel on Ulgrotha.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir slaughters the dwarves of the Castle of Morning Light and kidnaps the king's daughter, renaming her Irini Sengir.
timeline.quote: He turned her into a vampire, charming her to love him like a father and renaming her Irini Sengir .

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir frees the mad crone Ravi from a sealed coffin in the Dead Zone and names her Grandmother Sengir.
timeline.quote: In any case, the baron quickly sensed the magical prowess of the woman and he brought her to his castle , renaming her Grandmother Sengir .

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir sends vampires against Aysen and enslaves kidnapped humans in the Dark Barony.
timeline.quote: He instigated firm rules: if one person tried to flee the Barony, he would murder ten people in their place.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir meets Serra and Feroz and warns them not to interfere.
timeline.quote: After the arrival of Feroz , the Baron met the two planeswalkers and invited them to his castle.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir makes a deal with Eron, King of the Goblins.
timeline.quote: So, the two worked out a deal

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir turns Lord Ihsan into a shade and servant instead of a vampire.
timeline.quote: he made him into a shade and faithful servant.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Feroz's death, Sengir reprimands Serra, who leaves Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: shortly after, Serra left Ulgrotha.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac sees Sengir's vampire army march through the Dwarven Gate on the eve of the Great Mending.
timeline.quote: The Baron was last seen at the head of this army, walking through the Dwarven Gate .

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Through the portal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ihsan's Shade denounces Baron Sengir as the source of his pain.
timeline.quote: "Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain."

citation.text: Baron Sengir (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir explains Zeki's dead crew is pragmatism.
timeline.quote: "Zeki sails with a dead crew not out of villainy, but pragmatism."

citation.text: Reef Pirates (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir praises his Grandmother's mix of power and madness.
timeline.quote: "Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear Grandmother."

citation.text: Grandmother Sengir (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taysir calls the werewolves the Baron's lieutenants.
timeline.quote: "The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."

citation.text: Greater Werewolf (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reveka calls Irini Sengir Sengir's daughter in spirit.
timeline.quote: She is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood."

citation.text: Irini Sengir (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Daria sees the Baron in the face of every Sengir bat.
timeline.quote: "In the face of every one I see the Baron."

citation.text: Sengir Bats (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Halina predicts Veldrane will die serving the Baron.
timeline.quote: One day, he'll go to die."

citation.text: Veldrane of Sengir (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zeki describes Baron Sengir's mercilessness.
timeline.quote: but the Baron keeps no mercy in his vault of horrors."

citation.text: Torture (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir invades New Freedom, chases off the dwarves and turns Princess Irini into a vampire.
timeline.quote: even turned their princess Irini into a vampire whom he adopted as his daughter

citation.text: "Dwarf", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir finds out Bernatheen and twists him into a greater werewolf as punishment.
timeline.quote: Bernatheen was later found out by Baron Sengir and twisted into a greater werewolf as punishment.

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Serra gone, civilizations fight each other while Baron Sengir plots to take control under the fading Ban.
timeline.quote: the vampire Baron Sengir plots to take control of the plane under the fading Ban of Feroz.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra inquisitors raid the Death Speakers' homes, while Baron Sengir offers them black magic books to win control of them.
timeline.quote: which caused Serra inquisitors to raid their homes

citation.text: "Speaker", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir, stranded after two planeswalkers duel, slays or undeads the dwarves and takes the castle.
timeline.quote: they found that all of their kin had been slain or turned into undead by the Baron

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir captures Irini and turns her into a vampire.
timeline.quote: turned her into a vampire

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir frees the mad Ravi from her coffin and renames her Grandmother Sengir.
timeline.quote: He freed her from the coffin, and brought her with him, renaming her Grandmother Sengir.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz arrives and falls in love with Serra; Baron Sengir moves against them; Feroz founds the Wizards' School.
timeline.quote: with whom he quickly fell in love

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a laboratory accident and Serra is manipulated by Sengir into leaving the plane; the ban begins to fail.
timeline.quote: Feroz tragically died in a laboratory accident, and Serra was manipulated by Sengir to leave the plane in sadness and guilt

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac visits around 4500 AR and sees a vampire army under Ihsan's Shade, hinting at Sengir's conquest.
timeline.quote: Leshrac saw a vampire army marching in the night at the reluctant command of Ihsan 's Shade

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Ulgrotha Baron Sengir punishes a corrupt wizard savant by making him the first greater werewolf.
timeline.quote: was made into the first greater werewolf as punishment by Baron Sengir

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir states he killed the An-Zerrins.
timeline.quote: "The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."

citation.text: An-Zerrin Ruins (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir speaks to Autumn Willow about forests of corpses; she answers about fallen trees nourishing seedlings.
timeline.quote: "Every forest is carpeted with the corpses of a thousand trees."

citation.text: Deathgrip (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ihsan's Shade denounces Baron Sengir as the source of all his pain.
timeline.quote: The source of all my pain.

citation.text: Baron Sengir (Oversized League Prizes, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Feroz isolates Ulgrotha, giving Autumn Willow sentience; later Feroz's Ban fails and she tries to save the folk of An-Havva from Baron Sengir.
timeline.quote: gained sentience after the planeswalker Feroz isolated the plane of Ulgrotha from the rest of the Multiverse

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "Caretaker of the Wood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A column presents a sanitised biography of Baron Sengir, dismissing his cruelty as pragmatism.
timeline.quote: His positive attributes are talked up, while actions that would otherwise be seen as cruel or evil are dismissed as unimportant or simple pragmatism.

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "Immortal Gentleman and Politician". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir kills the An-Zerrins and then uses their ruins.
timeline.quote: ever since I first killed them.

citation.text: An-Zerrin Ruins (Masters Edition II, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir controls the Dark Barony from Castle Sengir on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: the vampire known as Baron Sengir controls a whole region of tightly clustered small villages

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In BOOM! Comics, Sorin Markov binds Sengir in a pocket dimension with obelisks.
timeline.quote: so he erected obelisks in the dwarven city and bound him in a pocket dimension, along with the dwarven vampires.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "BOOM! Comics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir drinks bottled life.
timeline.quote: Bottled life.

citation.text: Elixir of Immortality (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The first encounter between Feroz, Serra and Baron Sengir took place at An-Havva Inn.
timeline.quote: It was here that the first encounter between Feroz , Serra and Baron Sengir took place.

citation.text: "An-Havva", section "An-Havva Inn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir punishes Bernatheen by transforming him into a greater werewolf.
timeline.quote: Bernatheen was transformed into a greater werewolf by the Baron

citation.text: "Bernatheen", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stranded on the plane, Baron Sengir creates the barony, dominates the An-Zerrin and takes over a nearly completed Dwarven castle, driving the dwarves away.
timeline.quote: Baron Sengir created the barony when he was first stranded on the plane.

citation.text: "Dark Barony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir has subjects kidnap people from Aysen and steals a vessel of thirty-one families to populate his land.
timeline.quote: He ordered his subjects to kidnap people from Aysen .

citation.text: "Dark Barony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir sets a rule that for any who flee, ten others will be murdered.
timeline.quote: if one person tried to flee the Barony, the Baron would murder ten people in their place

citation.text: "Dark Barony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eron and the Baron make a secret deal: Eron supplies the villagers while Sengir stops hostile actions against the Koskun Mountains.
timeline.quote: When Eron became lord of Koskun Keep, he and the Baron worked out a secret deal

citation.text: "Dark Barony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra and Feroz are invited to dinner by Baron Sengir, who would rather they not disturb Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: they are invited for dinner at Baron Sengir 's place

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sengir manipulates the grieving Serra into leaving Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: Sengir, who manipulates her, talking her into leaving Ulgrotha

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "Sengir's Triumph". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir begins a campaign against the dwarves, turns Irini into a vampire and adopts her as his daughter.
timeline.quote: When the Baron Sengir began his campaign against the dwarves, he turned Irini into a vampire and adopted her as his daughter.

citation.text: "Irini Sengir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Feroz's death, Serra failed to save a man from a runaway cartwheel, and Baron Sengir convinced her to leave Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: Baron Sengir appeared and convinced Serra to leave Ulgrotha altogether.

citation.text: "Onella", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baron Sengir creates Ihsan's Shade on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: created by Baron Sengir

citation.text: "Shade", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Joskun finds Zeki's zombie crew repulsive and keeps his distance, while Baron Sengir acknowledges Zeki's pragmatism.
timeline.quote: Baron Sengir acknowledged Zeki's pragmatism

citation.text: "Zeki", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
